findings.text: bats_execute now sets PATH from $BATS_SAVED_PATH, but the patch doesn't define it, and the only other reference in this directory is the patch itself. The old code used $BATS_PATH. If the variable is unset, PATH becomes empty, so any command run through bats_execute, such as `bats_execute sed ...` or `bats_execute date`, fails with 'command not found'. If it is set to a different value, the saved-path semantics change. I couldn't search the rest of the repo, so the definition may exist elsewhere.
